The `ifAdmin` modifier securely restricts sensitive functions (`upgradeTo`, `upgradeToAndCall`) to the trusted admin, and the overridden `_willFallback()` function correctly prevents the admin from interacting with the implementation, adhering strictly to the Transparent Proxy pattern. No exploitable vulnerabilities were found.
